ideas.pitch: A meta-prompting workspace and evaluation harness built specifically for Google Antigravity to automatically benchmark, score, and iteratively refine complex system prompts.
ideas.title: Antigravity Prompt Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the hackathon's specific focus on Google Antigravity, directly showcasing deep integration with the event's highlighted tooling.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that classifies incoming user prompts and directs them to the optimal specialized LLM endpoint based on intent vectors.
ideas.title: Semantic Prompt Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Imitates the architecture of a proven winner by applying efficient exemplar-based routing to solve context and model-routing overhead.

ideas.pitch: An automated pre-deployment risk and logic analyzer for AI-generated code snippets produced via rapid vibe coding workflows.
ideas.title: VibeCode Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the hackathon's explicit endorsement of vibe coding by solving the critical pain point of governance and reliability in fast-generated code.

ideas.pitch: An interactive playground where two distinct prompt-engineered agents debate or negotiate a scenario, writing reflection logs to continuously improve their prompt strategies without manual tuning.
ideas.title: Self-Improving Agent Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the self-improving feedback loop pattern that won the Datadog Self-Improving Agents Hack, demonstrating autonomous optimization.

ideas.pitch: A local-first terminal tool that intercepts, logs, and analyzes prompt token efficiency and hallucination flags in real-time during local development.
ideas.title: PromptLens CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the developer experience angle emphasized in prompt-based challenges by providing immediate, tangible utility for anyone building with AI.
